articles.image_title: Sicherheitspolitik: BRUSSELS, BELGIUM - JANUARY 22: General Alexus G. Grynkewich, Supreme Allied Commander Europe (SACEUR) attends the NATO Military Committee Session on January 22, 2026 in Brussels, Belgium. NATO's Military Committee is holding its first Chiefs of Defence (CHOD) session of the year chaired by Admiral Giuseppe Cavo Dragone. The meeting includes CHODs from all 32 NATO Allies, strategic commanders, and partners, focusing discussions on improving readiness, deterrence, military innovation, and support for Ukraine.
